facts.fact: RISA's CTO told The New Times that Rwanda is establishing a national data sharing platform, to be built in phases from requirements and design through core platform development integrated with pilot systems, with launch of a fully operational portal planned for 2026 and a firm still to be onboarded.

systems.platform: to be built on APIs, metadata structures and standard data formats; cloud or hybrid infrastructure
systems.owner: Ministry of ICT and Innovation; implemented by RISA
